data.description: Rename the Instance panel to Server in plain organizer language (ruling 2026-08-14, sequence/org-settings-design.md iteration 3; design contract prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 v1.15 #org/server). Head: 'What this Marquee is connected to, and whether each piece is working.' Rows lead with the job — Email sending · File uploads · Spam protection · Web address — service names (Resend, R2, Turnstile) as small print; chips read working / not set up. The mail row names the connected Resend sender and account (derived from real config, never a stored flag — extend GET /api/v1/instance/status if needed) and offers an Open Resend link out. Applies everywhere the panel renders (setup dashboard D8 panel + steady state). Steady-state placement is a tab of the org-settings surface MRQ-207 is building in parallel: if 207 has merged when you integrate, mount there (route org/server, redirect org/instance); otherwise mount behind your own route and say so in the PR. Recovery card copy per prototype ('no passwords, ever').
data.title: Server panel: plain-language connections, named Resend account

data.body: Planning complete and baseline recorded. Drove binding prototype org/server: four job-led rows (Email sending, File uploads, Spam protection, Web address), working/not set up state, named Resend sender/account with Open Resend link, and No passwords, ever recovery card. Baseline on de189c0e: npm test pass-over-budget (174 files/1212 tests; 340054ms vs 45000ms), contract tests 227 passed; expected missing local secret warnings. Implementation worker dispatched in the named worktree; MRQ-207 is not merged, so standalone org/server seam is required.

MRQ-210 validation evidence for exact pushed HEAD 3c0ddd2bc955d19df30d22e55e9ff15345e0c1cc.

Real local Worker/browser validation was performed on 444de4f1d46a2b49e68c42f7f730db0cfcd3864f after the implementation fixes. The only change from that implementation head to the current HEAD is the three test-title prefixes in 3c0ddd2b; no runtime or source files changed.

Using a seeded local D1 Worker and local-only dummy Resend bindings, an authenticated demo-organizer browser session observed:
- /org/server rendered the four rows in order: Email sending, File uploads, Spam protection, Web address.
- Provider small print rendered Resend, Cloudflare R2, and Cloudflare Turnstile.
- Email sending showed working, “via Resend · sending as marquee@stage11.systems · account stage11-agentics”, and an Open Resend ↗ link whose href was https://resend.com.
- /org/instance settled at /org/server and rendered the same Server panel.
- c11 browser errors reported none after authentication. The initial unauthenticated load showed the expected session-expired UI and 401 responses; signing in as the demo organizer recovered the page.

Current-head checks: tsconfig.json, tsconfig.client.json, and tsconfig.test.json typechecks PASS; node contracts PASS (AC-281, AC-284, AC-287, and Server panel); focused Vitest PASS (instance-status 2/2 and AC-284 1 passed / 13 skipped); trace:ac -- --scope=merged PASS (235 live, 260 test files, 74 claims, 0 uncovered). Fresh independent exact-head review returned VERDICT: APPROVE. Full local pr-gate remains suspended under the documented fleet load event; CI owns it. No merge.

Files changed: .dev.vars.example; docs/ROUTES.md; src/index.ts; src/jobs/mail/consumer.ts; src/lib/instance-status.ts; src/lib/mail/config.ts; src/routes/instance.routes.ts; src/ui/settings/ServerPage.tsx; src/ui/settings/settings.css; src/ui/setup/InstancePanel.tsx; src/ui/setup/ServerPanel.tsx; src/ui/setup/setup.css; src/ui/shell/AppShell.tsx; src/ui/shell/route-table.ts; tests/integration/cold-start.AC-275-286.test.ts; tests/node/cold-start-docs.AC-281-284-287.test.mjs; tests/node/server-panel.MRQ-210.test.mjs; tests/unit/instance-status.MRQ-210.test.ts; wrangler.jsonc. AC-281 repoint decision: InstancePanel remains the setup-dashboard compatibility wrapper, while ServerPanel deliberately owns /api/v1/instance/status, so the structural contract points to ServerPanel instead of contorting production code. Identity-module design: one shared Resend identity/config seam is consumed by the Worker status route, mail consumer, and ServerPanel; sender/account derive from RESEND_API_KEY plus the configured RESEND_ACCOUNT_NAME admitted by Wrangler, never from a stored flag or invented identity. Test results at exact head 3c0ddd2bc955d19df30d22e55e9ff15345e0c1cc: three TypeScript projects PASS; node AC-281, AC-284, AC-287, and Server panel contracts PASS; focused Vitest instance-status 2/2 and AC-284 1 passed / 13 skipped; trace:ac merged PASS with 235 live, 260 test files, 74 claims, 0 uncovered; real local browser showed the four Server rows, provider labels, configured sender/account, Open Resend link, and /org/instance redirect. PR 257 merged as 381f83820ed1850490961dd4a9ebb4473a4d711e; full local gate was suspended under the documented load event and CI was authoritative.
